static_inspection.note: The recordings from this first run are excluded: taking repeated canvas screenshots stalled rendering and changed the recorded framing.
static_inspection.pixelMetric: Per-pixel max absolute RGB channel difference, 0..255; alpha ignored; nearest-rank quantiles. Historical conduction pairs combine normals and dash distances.

playback_inspection.visual_review: Recorded video frames were inspected at 0.25-second intervals. This is a display-defect check, not validation of real-device frame rate or exact playback speed.

report.pixelMetric: Per-pixel max absolute RGB channel difference, 0..255; alpha ignored. Percentiles use nearest rank. Nonzero statistics exclude equal pixels; no pass/fail threshold.

native_evidence.selection: largest mean or largest maximum pixel difference in its mode, plus largest mean at 370ms

retention.permanent: Native selected PNG pairs, difference heatmaps, montages, metrics and all 10 transcoded MP4 videos are tracked in git. Remaining raw PNG/WebM files expire with the artifact.
retention.video_transcode: ffmpeg libx264 CRF 30, veryfast, yuv420p, no time scaling, audio omitted (source silent). MP4 is a lossy copy of the corresponding play-*.webm.
